summary: Jefferies Financial Group Inc. filed an 8-K announcing the pricing of a public offering of $1.1 billion aggregate principal amount of 5.125% Senior Notes due 2031, with an effective yield of 5.304% and maturity on April 28, 2031. The offering is expected to settle on April 28, 2026, subject to customary closing conditions. Net proceeds will be used for general corporate purposes. Jefferies LLC acted as sole global coordinator and joint book-runner. This is a routine debt capital markets transaction and does not constitute a special situation event; therefore, no deal terms are applicable.
